feedback.source: Van de Pol, Volman & Beishuizen (2010), Framework for Analysis of Scaffolding Strategies: feeding back.
feedback.preference: The teacher gives the student information about the student's own performance.

hinting.source: Van de Pol, Volman & Beishuizen (2010), Framework for Analysis of Scaffolding Strategies: hints.
hinting.preference: The teacher offers clues or suggestions that help the student move forward without giving the full solution or detailed instructions.

instructing.source: Van de Pol, Volman & Beishuizen (2010), Framework for Analysis of Scaffolding Strategies: instructing.
instructing.preference: The teacher tells the student what to do or explains how it should be done and why.

explaining.source: Van de Pol, Volman & Beishuizen (2010), Framework for Analysis of Scaffolding Strategies: explaining.
explaining.preference: The teacher provides more detailed information or clarification.

modeling.source: Van de Pol, Volman & Beishuizen (2010), Framework for Analysis of Scaffolding Strategies: modelling.
modeling.preference: The teacher demonstrates behavior or a skill for the student to imitate.

questioning.source: Van de Pol, Volman & Beishuizen (2010), Framework for Analysis of Scaffolding Strategies: questioning.
questioning.preference: The teacher asks questions that require an active verbal and cognitive answer from the student.
